name: googletest
description: GoogleTest - Google Testing and Mocking Framework
one_liner: The standard, free toolkit developers use to write and run automated tests for C++ code.
buyer: Not really — this is foundational developer infrastructure that everyone uses for free, not a resellable product.
business_use_cases: A C++ shop adopts it as their standard testing framework instead of building one in-house.
A consultancy offers 'test coverage audits' for legacy C++ codebases, using it as the framework to backfill tests.
A training company sells a 'testing C++ the right way' course built around it.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a paid 'add test coverage to your legacy C++ codebase' consulting service using it as the framework.

steal_this: Not a product opportunity — at most, offer legacy C++ test-writing as a paid consulting gig this month.
